issues.explanation: This span hides the personal name 曹腾 inside a larger ordinary noun phrase.
issues.suggested_fix: Split as 宦官 + 曹腾 (name) + 养子.

issues.explanation: Here 字 introduces Cao Cao's courtesy name, not a letter.
In 好游猎, 好 is the verb hào, meaning to enjoy or be fond of, not hǎo “good.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use pinyin hào and gloss “to enjoy; be fond of.”

issues.explanation: 善权谋 means “to be skilled at strategy,” not simply “good.”
曾 is céng here, marking a past occurrence, not the surname Zeng.
issues.suggested_fix: Use pinyin céng and gloss “once; previously.”

issues.explanation: 曾 here is an aspectual/time adverb meaning “once; previously,” so the surname gloss materially misleads the learner.
In 举孝廉, 举 means to recommend or select someone for the xiaolian honor/office, not an unglossed character variant.
孝廉 is a lexical historical term and should not be split into two character-level dictionary entries.
issues.suggested_fix: Combine 孝廉 and gloss it as “xiaolian recommendation/title.”

issues.explanation: 左丰 is a two-character personal name; splitting it leaves the following character with an unrelated gloss and hides the name.
issues.suggested_fix: Combine 左丰 as the name Zuǒ Fēng.

issues.explanation: 时 here is the temporal word “when,” not the surname Shi.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “when; at the time that.”

issues.explanation: 救董卓 means “rescued Dong Zhuo”; the current dictionary-style variant gloss does not explain the word.
怒而要杀他 means Zhang Fei “became angry” or “was enraged,” not the noun “anger.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to become angry; be enraged.”

issues.explanation: 要杀他 means “want/intend to kill him,” not the bound verb “to demand.”
留待下回分解 is a stock narrative phrase meaning the matter is left to be explained in the next installment; “to leave for later” is too incomplete in this local context.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to leave for (a later time/episode).”

issues.explanation: In this chapter-ending formula, 分解 means “explain; tell what happens,” not “resolve.”
